svg.text: the framework guards what reaches the repository — clean
Scenario: a secret is blocked without copying its value into the scan log
Ordinary work passes in both modes
A detected value stays out of the log

g.text: Given clean framework projects use Docker and binary scanners from
The install answer chooses Docker or the checksum-verified binary. Both projects have a
clean commit and a clean staged change; no scan is empty.
Then full scans pass on ordinary files in both modes
And staged scans pass on ordinary changes in both modes
And branch scans pass on ordinary commits in both modes
When a synthetic password is committed and staged in both projects
Only a synthetic password is used. One line is committed and a second is staged, so all
three scan paths have a real finding to block.
Then full scans block the secret and redact its value in both modes
The complete native output is checked before any display normalization. All six scans must
fail, name the file and line, identify generic-password, and hide the value.
And staged scans block the secret and redact its value in both modes
And branch scans block the secret and redact its value in both modes
